Three samples of the pipeline on Opus 5.5 over all 24 evaluation papers (claims within tolerance of the paper's printed value).  *Sample 1* is the model-matched row used everywhere else in this report: the API run (`claude-opus-5-5`) for Grier, Leeson, Manekin and Montero and the first oracle run for the other twenty.  *Sample 2* is a second oracle run (label `desktop-opus-run2`; `pipeline-oracle-desktop-opus-run2-13papers-all-modes-2026-10-23.json` for the 13 earlier papers, `pipeline-oracle-desktop-opus-run2-4papers-all-modes-2026-11-02.json` for the four of ROADMAP 3.6, `pipeline-oracle-desktop-opus-run2-6papers-all-modes-2026-11-02.json` for the six of ROADMAP 3.7, `pipeline-oracle-desktop-opus-run2-1paper-all-modes-2026-11-06.json` for the R7 paper of ROADMAP 3.9), so for the four API papers the samples differ in route as well as draw.  *Sample 3* is a third oracle run on the frozen pipeline (label `desktop-opus-run3`; `pipeline-oracle-desktop-opus-run3-23papers-all-modes-2026-11-03.json` for the 23 earlier papers, ROADMAP 3.7.4; `pipeline-oracle-desktop-opus-run3-1paper-all-modes-2026-11-06.json` for the R7 paper, ROADMAP 3.9).  The agent column is its first sample.  The columns marked (1, 2) compare pipeline samples 1 and 2 cell by cell (paper × mode); *cells identical (1, 2, 3)* counts the cells with the same final count in all three samples and *max spread* is the largest difference between a cell's highest and lowest sample.
